evidence_quotes.O: I was one of the first to download the full-featured Nikon NX software on a trial basis in July 2006. I was immediately hooked.
evidence_quotes.C: On the competent advice of my IT professional, I bought this unit to back up my home office and digital photograph library.
evidence_quotes.E: Obviously, I am enamored with the Nikon D80.
evidence_quotes.A: For those not familiar with RAW format, essentially a RAW format photo file enables the photographer to make post-shot changes to a photo
evidence_quotes.N: This lens has only two "faults." First, it is big and heavy--quality construction often yields a heavy lens.
